items: With Plus in the UK, two recommended TV guides are added by default so a match's Sky Sports or TNT Sports channel is found. Turn them off in Settings, Playlists and Guide.
Sports falls back to your App Store country when your device's region isn't one Amaviro knows.
The privacy policy names the recommended guides' sites.

description: Find the match. Fix the stream. Keep watching. Amaviro is a TV player for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV that finds the channel showing your game and sorts out what goes wrong, on the TV service you already pay for.
